Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=6][b]Grass Variety[/b][/size]
New grass framework.

[url=https://github.com/Mushymato/GrassVariety/tree/main]Source Code[/url]

[size=5][b]For Authors[/b][/size]
See [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/GrassVariety/blob/main/docs/author-guide.md]author-guide.md[/url] for how to make content pack for this mod using content patcher.

[size=5][b]For Players[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]Install this mod by extracting it and placing it in your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
The [font=Courier New]DefaultGrassWeight[/font] config changes how frequently the vanilla grass texture ([font=Courier New]TerrainFeatures/grass[/font]) appear. The default is 0, but you may use this to allow some compatibility between content packs using this mod and content packs that directly retextures the grass.

At the moment it can be set via console command [font=Courier New]gv-default_grass_weight [weight][/font] or by editing [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], no GMCM support for now.

[size=5][b]Compatiblity[/b][/size]
This mod is not compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url] which patches draw directly and takes effect over this mod completely. There are no plans to introduce direct compatibility due to feature overlap and conflicting design choices.

However as of 1.2.0, you can have Grass Variety load content packs made for More Grass by changing some manifest fields, [url=https://github.com/Mushymato/GrassVariety/blob/main/docs/more-grass-shim.md]see here for how to[/url].
